name: Get Worker Environment Script Content
description: Get Worker Environment Script Content Get Worker script content for an environment. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/services/{service_name}/environments/{environment_name}/content
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/services/{service_name}/environments/{environment_name}/content
Get Worker script content for an environment.
Required: account_id (path); service_name (path); environment_name (path)

name: Replace Worker Environment Script Content
description: Replace Worker Environment Script Content Replace Worker script content for an environment. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/services/{service_name}/environments/{environment_name}/content
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/services/{service_name}/environments/{environment_name}/content
Replace Worker script content for an environment.
Required: account_id (path); service_name (path); environment_name (path); body (body)
Optional: CF-WORKER-BODY-PART (header) — The multipart name of a script upload part containing script content in service worker format. Alternative to including in a metadata part.; CF-WORKER-MAIN-MODULE-PART (header) — The multipart name of a script upload part containing script content in es module format. Alternative to including in a metadata part.
